name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Delays a click by a few physics ticks when clicking now would kill you but clicking slightly later would not.

mode.name: Buffer Mode
mode.description: Largest delay (in physics ticks, 240 per second) the mod may add to a click to keep you alive. <cy>Disabled</c> passes every input through untouched.

cycle-mode.name: Cycle Mode Key
cycle-mode.description: Cycles Disabled -> 1 -> 2 -> 4 -> 6 -> 8 -> 10 -> 12 -> 14 -> 16 ticks while playing a level.

buffer-releases.name: Buffer Releases (Wave)
buffer-releases.description: Also delay <cy>releases</c> in wave, where letting go at the wrong tick kills just like pressing does.

ignore-two-player.name: Ignore 2-Player Mode
ignore-two-player.description: Plays <cy>2-Player</c> levels like normal dual: every click and jump key controls both players. Levels built around split controls can become impossible.

show-status.name: Show Status Label
show-status.description: Shows the current mode and the last saved input in the corner while playing.

log-saves.name: Log Saved Inputs
log-saves.description: Writes a line to the Geode log/console each time an input is delayed.

jump-horizon.name: Click-Mode Lookahead
jump-horizon.description: Most ticks to look ahead after a click in cube, robot, ball and spider. A prediction normally ends sooner: when you land or reach the next orb.

hold-horizon.name: Flying-Mode Lookahead
hold-horizon.description: Most ticks to look ahead after an input in wave and UFO. A prediction normally ends sooner: a few ticks after your next click, timed from your own recent rhythm.

self-check.name: Prediction Self-Check (Debug)
self-check.description: Every 30 ticks, predicts where you'll be 30 ticks later with no input and logs how far off the prediction was. Useful for checking accuracy on a level.
